title: Substance Use Assessment (TAPS-2)
about: The second part of NIDA's TAPS Tool, for a positive TAPS-1: yes or no questions about each substance in the past 3 months. Each substance is scored on its own, by its number of Yes answers.

code.display: Tobacco, Alcohol, Prescription medications, and other Substance use assessment [TAPS]

source.name: The TAPS Tool, Part 2, NIDA Clinical Trials Network (Web Version 2.0, 09-19-17)

licence.holder: National Institute on Drug Abuse (NIDA) Clinical Trials Network
licence.terms: Developed in the NIDA Clinical Trials Network (CTN-0059); in the public domain.

blocks.text: These questions are about tobacco, alcohol, drugs and prescription medications in the PAST 3 MONTHS ONLY. Each question is answered Yes or No. Check the box to select your answer.

blocks.label: 1. Tobacco. Answer questions 2 and on only if you answered Yes to question 1.
items: In the PAST 3 MONTHS, did you smoke a cigarette containing tobacco?
In the PAST 3 MONTHS, did you usually smoke more than 10 cigarettes each day?
In the PAST 3 MONTHS, did you usually smoke within 30 minutes after waking?

blocks.label: 2. Alcohol. Answer questions 2 and on only if you answered Yes to question 1.
items: In the PAST 3 MONTHS, did you have a drink containing alcohol?
For women: In the PAST 3 MONTHS, did you have 4 or more drinks containing alcohol in a day?
For men: In the PAST 3 MONTHS, did you have 5 or more drinks containing alcohol in a day?
In the PAST 3 MONTHS, have you tried and failed to control, cut down or stop drinking?
In the PAST 3 MONTHS, has anyone expressed concern about your drinking?

blocks.text: One standard drink is about 1 small glass of wine (5 oz), 1 beer (12 oz), or 1 single shot of liquor.

blocks.label: 3. Marijuana. Answer questions 2 and on only if you answered Yes to question 1.
items: In the PAST 3 MONTHS, did you use marijuana (hash, weed)?
In the PAST 3 MONTHS, have you had a strong desire or urge to use marijuana at least once a week or more often?
In the PAST 3 MONTHS, has anyone expressed concern about your use of marijuana?

blocks.label: 4. Cocaine or methamphetamine. Answer questions 2 and on only if you answered Yes to question 1.
items: In the PAST 3 MONTHS, did you use cocaine, crack, or methamphetamine (crystal meth)?
In the PAST 3 MONTHS, did you use cocaine, crack, or methamphetamine (crystal meth) at least once a week or more often?
In the PAST 3 MONTHS, has anyone expressed concern about your use of cocaine, crack, or methamphetamine (crystal meth)?

blocks.label: 5. Heroin. Answer questions 2 and on only if you answered Yes to question 1.
items: In the PAST 3 MONTHS, did you use heroin?
In the PAST 3 MONTHS, have you tried and failed to control, cut down or stop using heroin?
In the PAST 3 MONTHS, has anyone expressed concern about your use of heroin?

blocks.label: 6. Prescription opiates. Answer questions 2 and on only if you answered Yes to question 1.
items: In the PAST 3 MONTHS, did you use a prescription opiate pain reliever (for example, Percocet, Vicodin) not as prescribed or that was not prescribed for you?
In the PAST 3 MONTHS, have you tried and failed to control, cut down or stop using an opiate pain reliever?
In the PAST 3 MONTHS, has anyone expressed concern about your use of an opiate pain reliever?

blocks.label: 7. Medications for anxiety or sleep. Answer questions 2 and on only if you answered Yes to question 1.
items: In the PAST 3 MONTHS, did you use a medication for anxiety or sleep (for example, Xanax, Ativan, or Klonopin) not as prescribed or that was not prescribed for you?
In the PAST 3 MONTHS, have you had a strong desire or urge to use medications for anxiety or sleep at least once a week or more often?
In the PAST 3 MONTHS, has anyone expressed concern about your use of medication for anxiety or sleep?

blocks.label: 8. Medications for ADHD. Answer questions 2 and on only if you answered Yes to question 1.
items: In the PAST 3 MONTHS, did you use a medication for ADHD (for example, Adderall, Ritalin) not as prescribed or that was not prescribed for you?
In the PAST 3 MONTHS, did you use a medication for ADHD (for example, Adderall, Ritalin) at least once a week or more often?
In the PAST 3 MONTHS, has anyone expressed concern about your use of a medication for ADHD (for example, Adderall or Ritalin)?

blocks.label: 9. Other drugs. In the PAST 3 MONTHS, did you use any other illegal or recreational drug (for example, ecstasy/molly, GHB, poppers, LSD, mushrooms, special K, bath salts, synthetic marijuana ('spice'), whip-its, etc.)?
items: Yes (1)
No (0)

blocks.label: If Yes: in the PAST 3 MONTHS, what were the other drug(s) you used?

fields.label: Medications for anxiety or sleep score

blocks.text: Each substance's score is its number of Yes answers; for alcohol, count the 4-or-more or the 5-or-more question, whichever was answered. Published cut-offs (McNeely 2016): for tobacco, alcohol and marijuana, 1 or more is problem use and 2 or more higher risk, a likely substance use disorder; for the other substances, 1 or more means assess further for a substance use disorder.
